723.text: The greater the sinner, the greater the right he has to My mercy.
723.polish: W każdej duszy dokonuję dzieła miłosierdzia, a im większy grzesznik, tym ma większe prawo do miłosierdzia Mojego.
723.notes: Polish checked 2026-09-27: koronkalednicka.pl selected-fragments PDF ('tym ma większe prawo'); adoremus.pl ('tym większe ma prawo', word order only); Ostrowiec sanctuary page reads 'prawa' (plural), probably a transcription slip; critical edition not opened. Literal: 'In every soul I carry out the work of mercy, and the greater the sinner, the greater the right he has to My mercy.' 'prawo' = right, title, claim. Parallel: Dz. 1182 (numbered 1181 in one source) 'im większa nędza, tym większe ma prawo do miłosierdzia Mojego' (the greater the misery, the greater its right to My mercy).

300/301.text: Proclaim that mercy is the greatest attribute of God. All the works of My hands are crowned with mercy.
300/301.notes: Wording agrees; the paragraph number does not (thedivinemercy.org: 300; other sites: 301). Cite without a number.
